The geometry behind that effect, including clipRingToBox — the function that cuts projected rings to the viewport so Chromium does not drop an oversized clip-path (a dropped mask reads as full coverage).
The committed design tokens. Reader-facing polish follows these and never a new ad-hoc scale.
The design system the tokens serve.
The visual measurement for the state effect — what the mask covers, anchored to real lng/lat projected through the live map.
The visual measurement for the meetings panel — paint rather than DOM, because the DOM was never wrong.
The snapshot write and read path, and reconcileCounts() — the four equalities that close fresh + carried = total. The most recently rebuilt thing in the repo, and the reviewer has never seen it.
The counts invariant under test, at the real scale (193 fresh + 24 carried = 217).
